1647153.overview: Six contestants compete in a high-stakes live TV quiz show to solve a complex "closed-circle" murder mystery for a 10 billion yen jackpot.

1647409.title: Desperada
1647409.overview: Desperada follows a deeply traumatized young woman rescued from the streets and brought to a shelter for the mentally ill, where—amid broken souls and painful pasts—she discovers healing and unexpected love that proves even the most damaged hearts can still hope.

1649649.title: Just Friends
1649649.overview: Returning to her hometown, Masha meets Pasha, whom she hasn't seen for many years. Together they overcome the death of a beloved one thus coming closer to each other. But their lives, full of dreams and losses, are rather different and drive them apart again and again. Each meeting brings back the old spark, but neither can decide to anything more. Through trauma and failure,they mature, learn to love, and try to figure out who they are to each other.

1652401.title: Scissors
1652401.overview: Follows a slasher with a grudge who meets his match when a group of queer friends on a weekend getaway turns his killing spree into a bloody night he never saw coming.

1653169.title: Columbine Shooting: Minute by Minute
1653169.overview: A detailed, minute-by-minute account of the Columbine High School shooting, exploring how the attack unfolded, the actions of the shooters, the responses of students, teachers, and law enforcement, and the critical moments that defined the tragedy. This documentary examines the timeline, decisions, and chaos that made it one of the deadliest school shootings in U.S. history.

1656113.title: Kanibal
1656113.overview: When a mayor pushes to privatize their public market, a struggling meat vendor confronts the brutal cost of “progress.”

1660401.title: Northern Soul: Still Burning
1660401.overview: An exploration of the cultural phenomenon that is Northern Soul, charting how this movement has weaved and transformed itself musically and culturally through the decades. Northern Soul continues to re-invent itself more than any other music genre, remaining as vibrant and relevant today as when it first evolved.  Features exclusive interviews with Richard Searling, Paul Mason, Elaine Constantine, Kev Roberts, Russ Winstanley, David Nathan, Wayne Hemingway, Dave Evison, Keith Gildart, Levanna McLean, Tony Blackburn and many, many more.
1660401.trailerName: Northern Soul: Still Burning | Official UK Trailer | In UK Cinemas 1st May 2026

1661297.title: Prize
1661297.overview: A young rower is pushed beyond his limits by an ambitious new coxswain.

1662897.title: Résilience
1662897.overview: Joseph is an isolated elderly Deaf man who lives alone and likes it that way. When his nephew gifts him a computer, he reluctantly learns to use the internet, which opens an unexpected door into his past.

1666033.title: Duang with you
1666033.overview: After a festival confession, art student Duang sets out to win over a guarded music major, slowly turning first love into a safe haven for them both.

1667697.title: Tanah Sengketa
1667697.overview: Yuni, a research student, opens a free learning class for children in Kampung Degong. Raka, a local youth who supports her, provides some needed books for the children. Terror begins to haunt Yuni. Despite warnings, Yuni refuses to give up and seeks to uncover the truth behind the strangeness.

1670513.title: Asteroid-77F
1670513.overview: On a remote asteroid lost in deep space, where the lifeblood of interstellar war - the precious resource known as neoleum - is extracted, three workers find themselves caught in events that challenge everything they once believed. Trapped within a labyrinth of iron and concrete, the heroes must find a way to survive and unravel the truth behind the chaos.

1673393.title: Krishnavataram Part 1: The Heart (Hridayam)
1673393.overview: An epic devotional narrative that reimagines the journey of Lord Krishna, tracing his path from Dwarka to Kurukshetra after parting ways with Radha. As his journey unfolds, it explores his connection with people, his layered personality, and the lessons he imparts about love and life.
1673393.trailerName: Krishnavataram Part 1: The Heart (Hridayam) | Official Trailer

1686577.title: My Hero Academia: I am a hero too
1686577.overview: Eri, the girl Deku rescued, has grown up and is now a high school student. In the final episode, she was seen smiling with a guitar case on her back, and now she visits U.A. High School, determined to pursue her dreams once again.

1689329.title: Lions in Winter
1689329.overview: Opening with a tragic crime, whose perpetrator attempts to hide his tracks, including his relationship to people in power and organized crime. The father of the victim – his daughter – who thought he had left behind a life marked by violence, decides to seek justice on his own, crossing red lines from which there is no return. If there is anything more dangerous than a father defending his children, is a father who no longer has any children to defend.

1689969.title: OSCAR
1689969.overview: Oscar wants to be more confident. He envies his best friend Kevin’s effortless confidence and social skills. To change himself, Oscar volunteers for a coaching club at school, becoming a practice subject for an aspiring coach, Karen.

1693425.title: HOME MOVIES
1693425.overview: A compilation of recordings made between two friends in 2018.

1693617.title: Masterpiece
1693617.overview: Two passionate lovers unite their artistic souls on a canvas, channeling their deepest emotions and shared experiences. As their painting evolves, it becomes a reflection of their connection and relationship.

1695537.title: The Shark Next Door
1695537.overview: When global warming forced sharks to develop motor skills to survive amongst humans, Elliot, a kind-hearted young man, falls in love with Finn, a brooding and solitary shark

1696305.title: Bridge 704
1696305.overview: When paranormal livestreamer Jacie investigates the infamous Bridge 704 after a fan request, what begins as another ghost hunt quickly turns terrifyingly real. Directed by Dan Williams, the short blends urban legend horror and found-footage tension into a chilling supernatural encounter.
1696305.trailerName: Are the stories true? Will she survive?|Bridge 704

1698289.title: Party Princess
1698289.overview: Isabela, an undocumented street artist in princess garb, comes across a lost toddler on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, but time is pressing, and her immigration lawyer is waiting with a vital deadline.

1699953.title: Moon Song
1699953.overview: After the loss of her grandad, Ash gets stuck in a depressing cycle of loneliness and grief and struggles to get her life together.

1700081.title: My oh My !
1700081.overview: A woman takes drugs in a Los Angeles hotel, and has much to say.

1702641.title: Team Rudy
1702641.overview: In this warm, intimate, and often disarmingly funny documentary, director Nic Balthazar follows actor-writer Rudy Morren, who surrounds himself with a close-knit group of friends after being diagnosed with Parkinson's disease. As he undergoes major brain surgery, his “Team” grows into a powerful network of solidarity and hope. For creator Nic Balthazar, the project is also personal: his father also lives with Parkinson's disease.
1702641.trailerName: TEAM RUDY Trailer.  De nieuwe documentaire van Nic Balthazar.

1705201.title: Chi Mangia Solo
1705201.overview: On the night before selling their childhood home, an estranged brother and sister reconnect while cooking their late mother’s favorite recipe. They find their grief simmering just beneath the surface.

1707249.title: Wolfmask 2: The return of Dario Durant
1707249.overview: As the survivors try to rebuild their lives, Víctor, the brother of one of the victims, forms a group to stop what many believe is just a legend. But revenge never rests, and the past always finds a way to return.

1708593.title: JON BELLION - LIVE FROM FOREST HILLS STADIUM
1708593.overview: The full recording of 2 sold-out nights at Forest Hills Stadium in August 2025.

1709041.title: This Is How the World Ends
1709041.overview: When a war breaks out between humanity and the AI Machine States, the world is thrown into a state of confusion.

1711473.title: Bleda y Rosa. A Place, an Image
1711473.overview: Bleda y Rosa are one of the most significant Spanish visual artist couples of their generation. They are working on the installation of an out-of-context structure in the middle of the Valencian landscape. Of this entire process, only a single photograph must remain.

1713073.title: Transience
1713073.overview: Two homeless companions discover a magical hourglass with the power to rewind time… but only for ten seconds. They soon realise that this could be an opportunity to drastically change their situation. However, their plan requires two people, and neither one fully trusts the other.

1713457.title: White Musk
1713457.overview: Loosely based on the filmmaker’s own experiences, White Musk explores the tension that arises when a child is forced to parent their own parent. When her mother, Suraya, falls gravely ill, 19-year-old Hiba becomes her primary caregiver, while her older brother Hisham moves through the household largely unburdened. We watch Hiba and Suraya love each other and wound each other in equal measure, locked in a push and pull that neither knows how to break. As Suraya’s condition worsens, Hiba must navigate what it means to care for someone who cannot easily receive care, and what it costs her to keep showing up anyway.

1714801.title: Cheese Dreams
1714801.overview: Two rival cheese makers go head-to-head at their annual county village cheese fest.

1714993.title: Aryabhatt Ka Zero
1714993.overview: A directionless young man from a middle-class family struggles to find his place in a world that has already written him off. As life tests his resilience, he embarks on a heartfelt journey of self-discovery, hope, and finding the courage to believe in himself.

1716337.title: NJPW Road to G1 Climax 36 - Day 1
1716337.overview: The first night of Road to G1 Climax 36 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on June 19, 2026, at Chino Cultural Complex in Chino, Nagano, Japan.

1717233.title: Married Alive
1717233.overview: Single dad Mack & his soon-to-be-married son Tony may not survive their off-road camping trip when their Jeep overturns, trapping Tony underneath. With a storm coming, Mack has to find help to save his son from drowning.

1717745.title: Les Heures Mortes
1717745.overview: Camel, 20 years old, stifled by the violence of his social condition and his factory job, one day unintentionally triggers a global shutdown with a single sentence he utters. He nevertheless meets a girl his own age, unlike any other, who will offer him answers and a day outside of time that he will be forced to forget forever.

1717809.title: RADWIMPS 20th Anniversary Live Tour
1717809.overview: RADWIMPS celebrates 20 years since their major debut with this concert film, captured during their 17-show nationwide anniversary tour.

1717873.title: Blind spot
1717873.overview: After committing an irreparable act, a young deaf man seeks oblivion by isolating himself in a country house. As he resumes his normal life, paranormal phenomena begin to haunt his daily existence.

1718193.title: Detective McMan in the LABYRINTH OF LIES
1718193.overview: When movie director Howard Morrison is murdered, polar opposite detectives Geoffrey McMan and Drake Blake must solve the case. Can they find who murdered Howard Morrison before more people die, or will they themselves die trying?
1718193.trailerName: Detective McMan in the LABYRINTH OF LIES - Official Trailer

1719089.title: Mama
1719089.overview: While trying to terminate a pregnancy, a young woman is confronted with her first real adult experience.

1720113.title: Crimson Cove
1720113.overview: Outsiders on a bachelor trip arrive in a close-knit beach town where locals fiercely protect their territory. Tensions erupt, hidden traumas surface, and survival becomes a nightmarish spiral into madness.

1720305.title: Что ты здесь видишь
1720305.overview: Upon meeting Masha, Sanya felt something other than anger and apathy for the first time in a long time. But his attempt to keep her turned into an outburst of the very aggression he was trying to escape. Now he must face the consequences, realizing that he had destroyed the most precious thing he had with his own hands.

1722289.title: The Dress
1722289.overview: "The Dress" is an ode to ships passing in the night; the joy of the unfulfilled. It's also a love letter to dresses.

1722545.title: Permanent Damage
1722545.overview: Prison escapee Tommy Gods spirals into deeper trouble when he falls for Joe Plísek and is forced to work for her crooked uncle. Together, the couple plots to steal his "golden goose."

1723569.title: Be Forever Yamato - Rebel 3199 - Part 6: Blue Labyrinth

1724785.title: Feral
1724785.overview: A feral cat is caught and her kittens are taken away to be tamed.

1725553.title: The Blue Hour
1725553.overview: When a shadow emerges from the past, his last chance of survival might also be his enemy.

1726193.title: Bakuken: Honnoji Temple Annihilation Chronicles
1726193.overview: A new chapter in the Bakuken stage series, reimagining the Honnō-ji Incident within the franchise’s alternate-history world of legendary swordsmen. Further story details have yet to be announced.
1726193.original_title: 爆剣ー本能寺消滅記ー

1727409.title: Jodi
1727409.overview: A horror comedy made in Indianapolis about a woman named Jodi, a wannabe 80’s video vixen who likes locking men in her torture shed. Jodi loves her girlfriend TJ more than anything, and the feeling is mutual. So when TJ finds out about the shed, she tries her best to help the victims…but only makes it worse.  Jodi is a wild romp about the pleasures of rock n roll, sapphic love, and torture…don’t miss it!!

1727601.title: Reality Fatigue
1727601.overview: Reality Fatigue tells the story of Adam, a young man returning to his childhood home. In his dusty, neglected room, his mother smokes and longingly looks at pictures of him as a child. But when he enters, the world changes. The room is clean, his mom is holding a pen instead of a cigarette, and he has become a child, identical to the picture she was just looking at. They hug and all seems well, but Adam and his mom can’t keep reality at bay forever…

1727665.title: Akal Imitasi
1727665.overview: Set in the year 2029, the story focuses on an AI-based system called PIKO in schools, and how this technology widens the gap and leads to the loss of the true essence of learning.

1728113.title: Katseye: Wild Hearts
1728113.overview: A celebration to the group's new era and the fans who made it possible. Features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, Eyekons fan videos, and intimate interviews with the members.

1728305.title: Next Friday - Magical Meow Meow
1728305.overview: A teenage meow-gical cat-girl in training named Salem, must defeat her kaiju-nemesis, Gabby, by next Friday to pass her class! However, her younger sister Daisy seems to get in the way...

1730801.title: Case in Color
1730801.overview: A detective faced with stagnation in his career is suddenly thrusted into a new case that brings both romance and purpose in his life.

1732017.title: No address found
1732017.overview: Building on the discourse around the infamous area of molenbeek in Brussels, the filmmakers invite you on a walk in a patchwork of places held together as a floating concrete jungle where logic is substituted by interwoven spaces held in absurd rooms. The journey tries to follow the logic of those who designate an area as a bad one, detaching it from a broader context, as no man is an island.

1733809.title: The Cuts
1733809.overview: Theatre faculty spar over outlandish financial schemes to keep their department afloat. The arts are worth saving - but can these bozos do it?

1734577.title: Les métamorphoses, au féminin
1734577.overview: A schoolteacher reads aloud excerpts from the most poignant scene of violence against women in Ovid's Metamorphoses. As the ancient verses echo through the classroom, her students begin to recognize beneath the poetry  - the myths reveal themselves to be an unsettling mirror of contemporary reality.

1734769.title: In Alaska
1734769.overview: When a suicidal Inuk teen accidentally pierces an oil pipeline with a bullet, the FBI launches a full-scale manhunt across the northern wilderness.

1736497.title: Falling House
1736497.overview: A modest family on the outskirts of Tehran faces the imminent destruction of their home as a part of a vast redevelopment project. While Rashid, the father and a prison guard, is being accused of corruption, he discovers that his eldest daughter, Ensi, is secretly planning to leave Iran to become a model. As the bulldozers draw ever closer, the tensions within the household start to rise.

1739313.title: I Already had a Family
1739313.overview: A girl revisits her family and complications arise.

1742257.title: Aftermath
1742257.overview: A massacre survivor and a filmmaker form an unlikely bond as they slip down the rabbit hole of paranoia, in a desperate search for solace and truth.

1742513.title: Blanco
1742513.overview: On 11 July 1997, terrorist organisation Euskadi Ta Askatasuna (ETA) abducted Miguel Ángel Blanco, a 29-year-old councillor for the conservative Partido Popular in Ermua. The cell demanded that the Spanish government transfer their prisoners to jails in the Basque Country, threatening to kill Blanco unless conditions were met within two days.

1742897.title: Falling into Place
1742897.overview: Kaia returns home for her town's fall festival as well as her high school reunion and spends the week with her childhood best friend, James, to complete their unfinished fall bucket list.

1744177.title: Family Ties
1744177.overview: The director sits down with her grandparents, Elenea and Manuel Papelera as they look back at what they remember about growing up at the end and post WWII in Philippines under Japanese occupation and how being raised in that environment has affected them and how they’ve gone about raising their family. From memories of their youth, to deciding to pick up their lives and immigrating their family to Australia, to working laborious jobs to provide for their family. After sitting down with her Lola and Lolo, the director uncovers her connection to her Filipino heritage. After strife over two countries and three generations her family is still here now, betting over Mahjong games against their friends.

1744241.title: Your Personal Taxi
1744241.overview: A one-of-a-kind classic taxi carries passengers with seemingly ordinary lives but extraordinary stories, each journey accompanied by a song of their choosing.

1745201.title: Tashiro
1745201.overview: A documentary about Tashiro Island in Japan - also known as “Cat Island” - and the cat photographer who documents them.

1745841.title: The Fig Tree
1745841.overview: A girl finds herself in the crotch of a tree, abundant with figs - endless possibilities for her future, ripe and perfect, just within reach.

1746161.title: Soul Catcher
1746161.overview: Follows a gender-fluid Ts'msyen youth tasked with retrieving the soul of their great-grandfather's totem pole in this fluid, evocative animation about reclaiming history and righting the wrongs of a dark colonial past.

1746929.title: Mr. Creamjeans' Hidey Hole
1746929.overview: Henry, a man plagued by chronic pain and unresolved guilt, receives a chilling message: "I know what you did." The note leads him to The Hidey Hole, an underground museum of erotic nightmares, curated by the charismatic and unsettling Mr. Creamjeans. There, Henry is offered a chance to erase all traces of his secret crime... but only if he submits to a guided tour of the museum's most depraved exhibits. With every tale, Henry's pain worsens and his grip on reality slips, until he's forced to confront the twisted role he's played in the lives (and deaths) of others. By the end, Henry must decide: confess the truth and face the consequence, or lose himself to the Hidey Hole forever.

1747697.title: Feel Flows
1747697.overview: A beautiful memory is erased by the gushing water; place and people long gone, swept up by the tide.

1748081.title: Wakey Wakey
1748081.overview: Zombaby puts the fun in funeral in the gory sequel to the award-winning 'Teething Problems'.

1748913.title: Anchorage Point
1748913.overview: World renown architect struggles with the weight of his failed bridge design and the lives it claimed

1754161.title: The Double
1754161.overview: Inspired by Andersen’s tale, The Double follows a Scientist who releases his shadow, only to see it gain autonomy, power, and eventually replace him. Across ten tableaux of about two minutes each, the 20–30 minute experience traces this transformation through a sequence of dreamlike scenes blending realism and abstraction.

1757617.title: The American Teacher
1757617.overview: At an elite private school for the ultra-wealthy, an innocent new American teacher is caught between two rival high school girls vying for his favor and the prom queen's crown, only for a hidden and scandalous relationship to come to light.
1757617.trailerName: The American Teacher Film  - Official Teaser (2026)

1757937.title: O HOMEM TRAUMATIZADO
1757937.overview: A man who found a piece of paper with the worst thing about humanity written on it.

1758065.title: HOMONOMO
1758065.overview: Following a devastating rejection, Ethan (Charlie Walker) discovers a mysterious object  that makes him straight.

1759921.title: The Pilot
1759921.overview: A group of young simple men undertake the creation of a poscast, discussed their struggles with IB

1760241.title: Dust Bunnies
1760241.overview: A man's quiet night at home turns into a battle for survival when he unwittingly mixes a box of chemicals with the dust in his garbage unleashing a swarm of violent, hungry dust bunnies.

1760689.title: Birthing
1760689.overview: The life of an ambitious woman turns upside down once she becomes a mother and she desperately makes attempts to cope with the obstacles of this newly arisen situation.

1760753.title: DDT XX Century
1760753.overview: From Malevich’s “Black Square” to “Black Dog of St. Petersburg” — this is how DDT and filmmaker Sergei Kuznetsov defines the boundaries of the short 20th century. All the characters in the film are the heroes of DDT’s songs. Each episode is one track and one unique artistic method. The live‑action episodes alternate with chronicles, fragments of documentary films — both classic and little‑known — as well as with animation.

1761969.title: Wheel to Live
1761969.overview: After an accident, Nikos finds himself in a rehabilitation centre, confronted with a new reality. While the world around him keeps moving, he is called upon to redefine his relationship with his body, his boundaries and the course of his own life.

1763249.title: The Red Sound
1763249.overview: "The Red Sound" from "After Kandinsky: three Impressions" for piano Film and music composition by ELISA QUARELLO.

1763505.title: Better Future
1763505.overview: After four years as an immigrant in the United States, Julio, who works as part of the cleaning staff at a hospital, struggles to stay sober. Separated from his daughter and with his marriage in crisis, he searches for a fresh start amid the hardships of his daily life.

1764913.title: Apoplous
1764913.overview: Aggelis, an elderly boatbuilder, returns home following a serious health scare. Confronted with the limitations of his new reality, he has no option but to accept that he can no longer live with the freedom and independence he once enjoyed.

1766897.title: Glowurm
1766897.overview: A group of young eco-hackers infiltrates an abandoned experimental center in the Alps to document a space-time anomaly - a hidden dimension that transforms into a trap.

1767025.title: Help! My Room8te is Trying to Kill Me!
1767025.overview: Sam is anxious around their flatmate Jordan’s imminent move and whether their friendship will survive beyond it. The arrival of Big Tech’s latest invention changes the dynamic in the flat even more so in strange and mysterious ways. Through resisting this physical cyber-attack, unspoken feelings finally come to the surface.
1767025.original_title: Help! My Room8te is Trying to Kill Me!

1767665.title: On the hill
1767665.overview: On a farm situated on a hill at the Tunisian-Algerian border Gisela Bergman, a German woman in her eighties, lived for more than half a century. She bred a line of pure-bred Arabian horses and lived in harmony with nature, despite the harshness of the conditions. After her death, Amara, together with Zouhayer, continues the daily struggle to keep Mrs. Bergman’s dream alive.

1768753.title: Folded dreams
1768753.overview: A 10-year-old student quietly struggles under the overwhelming pressure of school, watching his childhood dreams slowly fold away

1769073.title: There’s A Unicorn In These Woods
1769073.overview: A window into a young man’s journey through loss, grief and acceptance. Alone and isolated in the Welsh hills, Hywel finds comfort and purpose in the pieces of life left behind.
1769073.original_title: There’s A Unicorn In These Woods

1770417.title: The Ones Who Bought Bushwick
1770417.overview: The Ones Who Bought Bushwick investigates the historical, political, and economic forces driving development and gentrification in Brooklyn’s Bushwick neighborhood.

1775793.title: Palindrome
1775793.overview: It is impossible for an opinion to be universally accepted. There is always another perspective to consider. Using wordplay as the basis of the narrative and the arrangment of cinematic elements into a cohesive whole, the film explores love as a complex and subjective concept whose interpretation depends solely on the individual.
